rounds.text:
Withholding pay gives a higher baseline payoff (5 tasks) even if the worker cuts corners, and it also signals distrust, which should encourage the worker to do the job properly. Since TRUST never yields more than WITHHOLD in any scenario, the safe choice is to withhold.
